chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Azzar from Muhammad ibn Isa from whom he mentioned from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) who said:

Say in Baghdad: Peace be upon you, O Wali of Allah. Peace be upon you, O Hujjah of Allah. Peace be upon you, O Light of Allah in the darknesses of the earth. Peace be upon you, O he whom Allah manifested in his affair. I have come to you knowing your right, opposing your enemies, so intercede for me with your Lord, and supplicate to Allah, and ask for your need, and convey this greeting to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him).
ai.seo_question: What is the text of the Ziyarah supplication for Imam al-Husayn in Baghdad?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this specific Ziyarah text highlights the theological concept of the Imam as the 'Proof of God' (Hujjat Allah) and the 'Light of God' in the earth's darkness, reflecting the Shia belief in the Imam's spiritual authority during the Minor and Major Ghaibah. It uniquely emphasizes the continuity of the Imamate by linking the supplicant’s intercession request directly to the conveyance of greetings to Imam Ali al-Baqir, thereby reinforcing the familial and spiritual lineage central to Shia devotion.
